scripts.build: cd packages/ui && npm run build && cd ../trace && npm run build && cd ../script && npm run build && cd ../bus && npm run build && cd ../model && npm run build && cd ../loop && npm run build && cd ../cli && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/ui && npm run build && cd ../trace && npm run build && cd ../script && npm run build && cd ../bus && npm run build && cd ../model && npm run build && cd ../loop && npm run build && cd ../cli && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:runtime-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:entry-graphs && npm run check:install-lock && tsc --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:update && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run install-lock
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run install-lock
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run install-lock
scripts.version:test: npm version prerelease --preid=test --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run install-lock
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run build:public-release && npm run check && node scripts/publish.mjs
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build:public-release && npm run check && node scripts/publish.mjs --dry-run
scripts.publish:test: npm run build:public-release && npm run check && node scripts/publish.mjs --tag next
